subject.title: refactor(infra): remove dead deprecated re-export alias

question: Should this standalone external refactor receive a maintainer-sponsored exception to the repository rule against unsolicited refactor-only PRs?
rationale: The patch itself is plausible, but repository policy intentionally leaves acceptance of standalone cleanup to maintainer judgment.

options.title: Decline Standalone Cleanup
options.body: Close the PR without merging and remove the alias later as part of owner-requested active work.

options.title: Sponsor The Removal
options.body: Approve the cleanup direction after the contributor supplies built-package proof and refreshes the branch against current `main`.

recommendation.title: Decline Standalone Cleanup
recommendation.body: Close the PR without merging and remove the alias later as part of owner-requested active work.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to recent package-export and SDK-surface maintenance.
